$schema: none — read by api/tests/test_fixture_rewrite_parity.py and agent/test/fixtureRewriteParity.test.ts
why: FIXTURE_SKIP_* / fixtureTargets) each rewrite every staged .ts file's
'@playwright/test' import to the depth-correct generated fixtures module.
The two implementations are separate ports in separate languages, and in #557
they had already drifted (*.config.ts at depth was skipped on the server and
rewritten on the device), which makes the SAME project pass on server-target
and fail collection on local-agent target.
This file is the single declared tree both test suites build and assert
against, so any future divergence fails a gate instead of a production run.
rule: Skip a .ts file when ANY of:
1. any directory segment of its path is node_modules, test-results,
2. its name ends with .d.ts (declarations have nothing to rewrite);
3. its name ends with .config.ts, AT ANY DEPTH (defineConfig lives only in
the real package, and config/*.config.ts is scaffolded into every project);
4. it is the ROOT fixtures.ts (the generated re-export site itself).
Root-only in (4) is load-bearing: a NESTED fixtures/authenticated.ts is a
genuine library file and MUST be rewritten.
Otherwise rewrite it, with the specifier '../' * depth + 'fixtures'.
